market_rationale: Large differences between energy, crypto and lagging cyclicals indicate high dispersion, although the aggregate dispersion statistic is missing. Inflation pressure, elevated yields and weak breadth argue against indiscriminate dip buying. Oil has independent inventory support, but its advance already discounts considerable strength. Quality pullbacks offer tentative reversal opportunities rather than compelling one-month edges. CPI occurs before the entry close, so its immediate reaction cannot be captured.
portfolio_rationale: Oil ranks first on modest, independently supported continuation rather than reversal. Cybersecurity and small value have the strongest tentative overreaction cases, but neither reaches the required 55% confidence threshold. The price-derived quality scores do not establish fundamental resilience. Consequently, no candidate qualifies under the fixed reversal rule, and benchmark exposure is preferable to forcing a selection.
